body: Dear avicus devolopment team, I like the anti- pay2win credit/cosmetic system on your server. When I was newer to the system I bought a badge and a trail not thinking about more expensive badges, I almost instantly regretted it. This is where my suggestion comes in, I think there should be a refund system for the cosmetic system. Now if this system were to be implemented, I feel the system should give full refunds just for the fact that these badges don't affect gameplay. I hope someone will consider this suggestion and thank you for your time.

replies.author: Sevoo
replies.body:
Make it so we can trade or sell them to other users. That way it's a win win. The player gets the badge without paying credits in the actual credit shop, which if you think about it is an endless void of credits to be spent, where none of it goes anywhere, and the other player gets the credits. Maybe we can have it like the Auction command in Faction servers? Example:

[Auction!] Vayrak is auctioning 1 Omega Badge! Starting bid: 80,000 Credits, (whatever you want here) Bid increment: 5 Credits (whatever you want here).

player1234 raised the price of Vayrak's auction of 1 Omega badge to 80,000 Credits!

hacker1234 raised the price of Vayrak's auction of 1 Omega Badge to 100,000 Credits!

We'd have a timer as well like:

The auction ends in 30 seconds!

The auction ends in 3

2

1...

I think this would be fun and add some variety to just buying something in a shop. I know I had fun with this back when I played Factions/Skyblock/Prison.
